nodes.title: The Question Paper will have 75 questions.

nodes.label: ii
nodes.title: All questions will be based on Subject-Specific Knowledge.
Education & Philosophy: Nature & Meaning of Education, Relationship between Philosophy &
Major Philosophies of Education:
nodes.body: Western Philosophy -Naturalism; Idealism; Pragmatism. Indian Philosophy – Vedant; Buddhism; Jainism.

nodes.title: Educational Thinkers & their Contribution in developing Principles of Education: Swami
nodes.body: Vivekananda; M. K. Gandhi: Basic Education; Tagore, John Dewey: Learning by doing; Rousseau.

nodes.title: Culture & Social Change: Concept & Dimensions of Culture; Relationship between Culture &
nodes.body: Education with special reference to conservative and creativity roles; Concept of social change and Roles of Education for social change; Social Stratification; Social Mobility; Pluralism and Diversity in Indian Society.

nodes.title: Psychology & Educational Psychology: Nature & Meaning of Psychology; Nature, Meaning and
Learning & Motivation: Concept of learning & Motivation; Factors of influencing learning – Personal
nodes.body: & Environmental, Techniques of enhancing learner’s motivation; S‐R Theory of Learning (Thorndike), Classical conditioning (Pavlov), Operant Conditioning theory of learning (Skinner) and Gestalt theory of Learning (Kohler et al), Cognitive theory (Piaget), Social development theory (Vygotsky).

nodes.title: Growth and Development: Concept, Stages of development, Role of hereditary and environment in the
Intelligence: Nature & Meaning, Measurement of Intelligence – Concept of I.Q, Verbal, Nonverbal&
nodes.body: Performance tests; Two‐factor Theory (Spearman); Multifactor Theory (Thurston); Structure of intellect (Guilford), Multiple Intelligence (Gardner).

nodes.title: Personality: Meaning & nature and Development of Personality – biological & socio‐culture
nodes.body: Determinants- a brief overview of Trait‐theory of Personality (Allport), Psycho analytical theory of Personality (Freud), Maslow’s hierarchy of needs and their educational implication.

nodes.title: Contemporary Indian Education System and Current issues: Development of Indian Education
nodes.body: system – Ancient Period (Vedic; Buddhist; Muslim), Various commissions, Reports and Policies (Wood dispatch; Hunter commission, Sadler Commission, University commission, Secondary Education Commission, National Education Commission, NPE 1986, NEP 2020), Major Constitutional Provision, Universalization of Elementary Education with special reference to Sarva Siksha Abhiyan; Education of children with special needs, Women’s Education, Education of Weaker Sections, Right to Education Act 2009.

nodes.title: Teaching Process: Concept of teaching; Characteristics & Functions of teaching; Principles & Maxims
nodes.body: of teaching, Bloom’s Taxonomy of instructional objectives – Cognitive, Affective & Psychomotor domains.

nodes.title: Techniques of Teacher‐Preparation: Microteaching ‐ Nature & Meaning, Main proposition, Phases,
nodes.body: Steps, Merits & Limitations; Simulated ‐ Nature & Meaning, Teaching Role Play, Advantages & Limitations; Programmed learning‐ Meaning & Characteristics, Learning ‐ Principles & Development of the Programmed instructions. ‐ Types. ‐ Merits & Demerits.

nodes.title: Methods of teaching: Role Play, Play Way Method; Project Method; Discussion method, Heuristic
ICT: Basics in ICT, Multimedia approach, Use of ICT in teaching learning process.
